notes:
3DM dimensions, a clearer gumball alignment and more reliable touchpad pinch.

### New
- Dimensions, texts, leaders and text dots in 3DM files now import as annotations with their plane, points and text height; edited dimension texts are kept.
- 3DM export writes annotations as their lines with a text label, and Dahu reads them back as the original annotations.
- Alias and shortcut commands are suggested while you type them; Fit and Zoom both find the Fit commands.
- Dropping a CAD or mesh file onto a document with objects asks whether to import it or open it, and opening asks to save your changes first.

### Improved
- The gumball alignment (World, Object, CPlane, View) now sits beside the Gumball toggle and only orients the gumball and typed moves and rotations: drawing planes and grids no longer change with it.
- The CPlane command has a World option to draw on the World planes again.
- Top, Front and Right keep a visible grid when the CPlane is seen edge-on.
- History and command history name what changed: Hide layer · Dimensions, Rename · Part → Lid, Rotate, Units · mm → cm.
- The status bar keeps snaps, Gumball and its alignment visible on narrower screens.
- The Set CPlane button moved to the View menu.
- Selection colours stay clearly visible in both themes, and a custom colour that is hard to see shows a warning.

### Fixed
- Touchpad pinch zoom no longer starts with a small orbit when the fingers move unevenly.
- The highlight of a gumball scale handle now reaches the centre.
- Imported dimensions with an edited text no longer offer a text field that cannot be changed.

---
Windows x64 installer with signed automatic updates and the corresponding AGPL source code. The installer is not Authenticode-signed: on first install choose **More info > Run anyway**.
